scripts.build:packages: pnpm --filter @open-glass-ui/core build && pnpm --filter @open-glass-ui/renderers build && pnpm --filter @open-glass-ui/react build && pnpm --filter @open-glass-ui/recipes build && pnpm --filter open-glass-ui build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run build:packages && pnpm --filter @open-glass-ui/next-fixture typegen && pnpm -r --if-present typecheck
scripts.release:check: pnpm run check && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test:unit && pnpm run verify:packages && pnpm run test:e2e && pnpm run bench:optics && pnpm run bench:browser
scripts.release:rc: pnpm run release:check && node scripts/assert-release-channel.mjs rc && changeset publish --tag next
scripts.release: pnpm run release:check && node scripts/assert-release-channel.mjs stable && changeset publish
